args: $sources = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath '${fileDirname}' -Filter '*.cpp' -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); if ($sources.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'No .cpp files found'; exit 1 }; & 'C:\dev\w64devkit\bin\g++.exe' '-g' '-O0' @sources '-o' '${fileDirname}\Main.exe'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
